tours.name: Finance: Accounting Module Basics
tours.description: A beginner walkthrough of the Accounting module for new finance users: opening Finance settings, navigating Accounts Receivable (Customer Invoices & Payments), Accounts Payable (Vendor Bills & Payments), Bank and Cash journals, setting up the Chart of Accounts (General Ledger), viewing the Trial Balance, and posting Journal Entries.

steps.title: Open the Accounting Module
steps.content: Click here to open the Accounting app. This is where you manage all finance operations: customer invoices (AR), vendor bills (AP), bank transactions, the general ledger and financial reports.

steps.title: Settings
steps.content: Go to Configuration > Settings. This is where the Finance module is set up: fiscal localization, default taxes, currency, invoicing and payment terms, and other company-wide accounting preferences.

steps.content: Accounting > Bank and Cash journals show all bank and cash transactions. Use this to review deposits, withdrawals and to reconcile your bank statements against accounting records.

steps.title: Journal Entries
steps.content: Accounting > Journal Entries is where all financial transactions are posted to the General Ledger, including manual entries. Click New to create an entry, add debit/credit lines, then click Post to confirm it in the books.

steps.title: Chart of Accounts
steps.content: Configuration > Chart of Accounts is where the General Ledger (GL) accounts are set up. Each account has a code, name and type (Asset, Liability, Equity, Income, Expense) that determines how it appears on financial reports.
